items.text:
У Ostranauts огромный потенциал, концепция космического бомжа-утилизатора реально затягивает. Но техническая сторона сейчас — это тихий ужас. Чем дольше идет одна игровая сессия, тем сильнее всё ломается. Начинают вылезать бесконечные ошибки, намертво пропадает интерфейс, а некоторые действия персонажей просто перестают работать. 

[b]Вдобавок к багам очень сильно душнят две вещи:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Катастрофическая нехватка места. Система хранения лута сделана максимально неудобно, из-за чего менеджмент вещей превращается в бесконечную рутину.
[*]Абсолютно тупой ИИ экипажа. Напарники постоянно творят дичь. Стоит включить высокую скорость времени, как они банально забывают надевать шлем от скафандра и просто задыхаются.
[/list]
Потенциал у игры топовый, но сейчас это слишком сырой продукт. Лучше дождаться.
items.text_zh:
Ostranauts拥有巨大的潜力，太空拾荒流浪汉的概念确实很吸引人。但技术层面目前简直是一场无声的恐怖。一局游戏进行得越久，一切就坏得越厉害。无尽的错误开始冒出来，界面会彻底消失，而角色的一些动作干脆停止工作。

[b]除了bug之外，还有两件事非常让人憋屈：[/b]
[list]
[*]灾难性的空间不足。战利品存储系统做得极其不方便，导致物品管理变成无尽的例行公事。
[*]绝对愚蠢的船员AI。同伴们不断干蠢事。一旦开启高时间速度，他们就会干脆忘记戴上宇航服的头盔，然后直接窒息。
[/list]
这款游戏的潜力是顶级的，但现在它还是一个过于半成品的产品。最好再等等。

items.text:
Игра, сама по себе, абсолютно уникальная. Очень аутентичный симулятор разборщика космических кораблей - свой личный можно собрать чуть ли не из того же мусора, превращая каждый разбор в своеобразный квест. Что не нужно, но дорого - отправить на продажу, этот пол и стены отлично ляжут рядом с моим - отправить в трюм и собрать из этого новый отсек. Приземленность всего происходящего действительно цепляет. Приходится следить за стрессом, голодом, жаждой, сном, даже туалетом - из-за этого со временем к своему кораблю привыкаешь как к детищу, зная предназначения каждых его закоулков. То, что вчера было железной коробкой спустя 50 часов превращается в самодостаточное пространство с бесконечной генерацией электричества, спальней, качалкой, кухней, курилкой, зоной для развлечения - да все, чего вашей душе угодно, благо с необходимостью путешествовать между планетами на посудине придется проводить недели не выходя.

Проблемы, в целом, начинаются практически сразу. Игра банально недоготовлена. Ваш стресс, например, это набор из 10 параметров, начиная от одиночества, заканчивая чувством собственной важности, держать в узде которые предлагают с помощью социального взаимодействия. Задумка интересная - любого НПС можно попытаться сделать своим другом, врагом, любовником - что угодно. Вот только сама система это какой-то нелепый набор из 20 действий, повышающих одни параметры и уменьшающих другие, из-за чего диалоги зачастую превращаются в закликивание одной опции 30 раз с результатом, который... даже не понятен? За одно нажатие ваши статы будут прыгать ТРИЖДЫ. Из-за этого трогать эту систему банально не хочется, оставляя ее либо на автоматизацию, либо используя другие, более простые методы. И так во многом - в Ostranauts действительно уйма механик, и лишь примерно треть из них кажется оформленной до конца. 

И все это было бы ничего, знаете, был в свое время такой разработчик - Питер Молинье - в каждой игре предлагал миллиард уникальных механик, и каждая выходила либо без них, либо с урезанными их версиями. Но в его играх всегда был шарм, уникальность никуда не девалась, держала тебя у экрана. И первые часов 40 я думал, что это первый на моей памяти пример своеобразного Молинье-лайка - абсолютно недоработанного проекта, который, однако, крайне увлекает. 

Так почему же, вы спросите, обзор негативный? Потому что игры Молинье [b]работали[/b].

Ostranauts это не 1.0. Даже близко нет. Эта игра НАВОДНЕНА багами. Вы будете встречать их повсюду, в каждой из игровых механик. Но до какого-то момента их можно терпеть. Можно терпеть тупейший АИ, можно терпеть НПС, которые выходят в космос без скафандра, неработающие опции в диалогах, лицензии, который меняют свою дату по истечению - это все можно терпеть. Но я рекомендую всем вылететь дальше первой локации и понять, что помимо, как мне кажется, двух третей фанбазы. там не были даже сами разработчики. Прилетев на Венеру понимаешь, что, ну, им просто наплевать. Каждый шаг вокруг Венеры забагован и мешает играть. Сюжетные миссии не работают. Летный интерфейс ломается после использования движка. Игра симулирует гравитацию Венеры и делает это НЕПРАВИЛЬНО - отталкивая от себя корабли вместо притяжения. 

И, казалось бы, ну окей. маленькая компания, инди, =терпим=, но если пооставлять баг-репорты и последить за реакцией на них разработчиков, то становится предельно ясно, что эта игра никогда не избавится от багов. 

Я, в целом, любитель поддержать мелкие проекты, оставить так называемый фидбек, порепортить баги - в общем, помочь сделать игру лучше. Так вот за свое время игры я оставил, кажется, семь баг репортов, реакцию получив на два, за две недели не исправлен не был ни один, даже из каких-то банальных, по типу неисчезающего со временем статуса "мозоли". Многие вещи, которые я встретил, я не репортил потому, что их репортили другие люди год назад - и с тех пор было ноль движений. Вы в какой нибудь игре видели, чтобы человек жаловался на кажущийся баг с гравитацией Венеры, получал какой-то жидкий ответ от разраба, шел и декомпилировал игру, находил строчку с ошибкой в коде, указывал на нее разрабам и не получал фикса в течение двух недель? Звучит как полный сюр, но маэстро за рулем Ostranauts так не думают. Те патчи, что выходят - это курам на смех. Там исправлений с десяток, но посты делают такие огромные, будто в каждом фиксов 100 - не меньше. 

В общем не тратьте свои деньги. Я редко согласен с подобными высказываниями, но игра сейчас натурально в какой-то бете, где все еще нормально (с большой натяжкой) сделана лишь первая локация. Да, собрать свой крупный корабль с нуля, научиться им управлять, чувствовать себя в нем уютно, чтобы прожить в нем неделю для успешного недельного полета на другую планету - это незабываемые чувства. Вот только на каждом шагу вам будут мешать, у вас будет что-то ломаться, а по прибытию вы увидите места, где не ступала нога не человека, а разработчика, который ввел эту зону 2 года назад и с тех пор, видимо, не трогал. Это все того не стоит.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏本身绝对独一无二。非常真实的拆解宇宙飞船模拟器——你几乎可以用同样的垃圾拼凑出自己的私人飞船，把每一次拆解变成一种独特的任务。不需要但很贵的东西——送去卖掉，这块地板和墙壁跟我的正好搭配——送进货舱，用它拼出一个新舱室。整个过程的接地气确实很抓人。你必须关注压力、饥饿、口渴、睡眠，甚至上厕所——因此随着时间推移，你会对自己的飞船像对自己的孩子一样习惯，知道它每个角落的用途。昨天还是个铁盒子，50小时后变成一个自给自足的空间，有无限的电力生成、卧室、健身房、厨房、吸烟区、娱乐区——只要你的心想要什么都有，好在由于必须乘坐这艘船在行星之间旅行，你得在里面待上几周不出来。

问题总体上几乎从一开始就出现了。游戏简直没做完。比如你的压力，是一组10个参数，从孤独到自我重要感，建议通过社交互动来控制它们。想法很有趣——任何NPC都可以试着变成你的朋友、敌人、情人——什么都行。只是这个系统本身是一套由20个动作组成的荒谬集合，提高一些参数、降低另一些，导致对话常常变成把同一个选项点30次，结果……甚至看不懂？一次点击你的属性会跳三次。因此根本不想碰这个系统，要么把它交给自动化，要么使用其他更简单的方法。很多地方都是这样——Ostranauts确实有大量机制，但其中大约只有三分之一看起来是完整做好的。

这一切本来也没什么，你知道，以前有这么个开发者——彼得·莫利纽——他在每款游戏里都提出十亿个独特机制，而每款游戏发售时要么没有这些机制，要么是它们的阉割版。但他的游戏总是有魅力，独特性从未消失，让你一直坐在屏幕前。前40个小时左右我以为这是我记忆中第一个类似莫利纽式的例子——一个绝对没做完的项目，却极其引人入胜。

那么你问，为什么是差评？因为莫利纽的游戏[b]是能运行的[/b]。

Ostranauts不是1.0。差得远。这款游戏被bug淹没了。你会在各处遇到它们，在每一个游戏机制里。但到某个时刻之前还能忍。可以忍受最愚蠢的AI，可以忍受不穿宇航服就进入太空的NPC、对话里不工作的选项、到期后改变日期的许可证——这些都能忍。但我建议所有人都飞出第一个地点之外，然后明白，除了我认为的三分之二粉丝群体之外，那里连开发者自己都没去过。飞到金星后你会明白，嗯，他们根本不在乎。金星周围的每一步都有bug，妨碍游玩。剧情任务不工作。飞行界面在使用引擎后就会坏掉。游戏模拟金星重力，而且做得不对——把飞船推开而不是吸引。

而且，看起来，好吧。小公司，独立，=忍了=，但如果留下bug报告并观察开发者对它们的反应，就会极其清楚地明白，这款游戏永远不会摆脱bug。

总的来说，我是个喜欢支持小项目、留下所谓反馈、报告bug的人——总之，帮助让游戏变得更好。所以在我游玩的时间里，我大概留下了七个bug报告，收到回应的有两个，两周内一个都没被修复，甚至包括一些很普通的，比如随时间不消失的“老茧”状态。我遇到的很多东西我没有报告，因为别人一年前就报告过——而从那以后零进展。你在哪款游戏里见过，有人抱怨金星重力的疑似bug，从开发者那里得到某种敷衍的回复，去反编译游戏，找到代码里出错的那一行，向开发者指出它，然后两周内都没得到修复？听起来完全荒诞，但Ostranauts的掌舵大师不这么认为。那些发布的补丁简直是笑话。里面大概有十来个修复，但帖子写得那么大，好像每个补丁里至少有100个修复。

总之别浪费你的钱。我很少同意这类说法，但游戏现在真的处于某种测试阶段，其中仍然（非常勉强地）做得还算正常的只有第一个地点。是的，从零开始拼出自己的大型飞船，学会驾驶它，在里面感到舒适，为了成功进行为期一周飞往另一颗行星的航行而在里面生活一周——这是难忘的感觉。只是每一步都会有人妨碍你，你会有东西坏掉，而到达后你会看到连人都没踏足过的地方，更别说开发者了，他在两年前引入了这个区域，从那以后显然没碰过。这一切都不值得。
总之，帮助让游戏变得更好。所以在我玩游戏的这段时间里，我大概留下了七份bug报告，只收到了两份的回应，两周内一个都没被修复，甚至是一些很普通的，比如那个不会随时间消失的“老茧”状态。我遇到的很多东西我都没报告，因为别人一年前就报告过了——而从那以后就是零进展。你在哪款游戏里见过，有人抱怨一个看似是金星重力bug的问题，从开发者那里得到某种敷衍的回复，然后去反编译游戏，在代码里找到出错的那一行，向开发者指出它，却在两周内都没得到修复？听起来完全是荒诞剧，但Ostranauts的掌舵大师们不这么认为。那些发布的补丁简直是笑话。里面也就十来个修复，但发的帖子搞得那么大，好像每个补丁里至少有100个修复似的。

items.text:
1.0, but still incredibly buggy. Give it a bit.

Pretty decent storylines, or at-least what they're consisting of so far is pretty good. The game, even after 'full release' is basically Bethesda-coded, with bugs that range from minor annoyances to "I had to restart my 60 hour save because of this ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ bug." And some of the worst combat I've seen in a game like this. 

Ideas to make the game less of a misery:
-Fix the horrible bug that disables your ability to actually construct anything, despite having the tools and items to do so
-Get rid of the annoying loading splash screen (Why do we gotta' click? Just load.)
-Fix the god-awful lag/stuttering/freezing issues
-Fix the scroll-wheel's zoom rubber banding after exiting a menu.
-Fix the horrible PDA files ui
-Fix the strangely low spawn rate for Heavy Water containers.
-Make it obvious which PDA is yours in the files menu
-Make it impossible for police to warrant you when a ship's transponder is off.
-O2 tank refill auto-shutoff
-Player-placed items REMAIN the player's property. (That's my battery charger, stop arresting me because I picked it up.)
-Allow docking at stations while towing a vessel
-Make most containers on-board ships and station private property so I can't just yoink someone's weed cigs.
-Different ways of reaching other planets without having to grind for RL days to get a Torch Drive.
-More space horror
-Add the transit kiosks in a tram-like station so we aren't just teleporting to other parts of stations.
-More advancements from certain NEOScavenger plots.
- Less tedious sleep/super-fast skip mechanic
- Refined auto-task coding (No, I don't want you to stand there with an empty power drill, PUT your fully charged back-up battery in it!)
items.text_zh:
1.0，但仍然bug多得离谱。再给它点时间吧。

剧情还算不错，至少目前的内容相当可以。这游戏即使在“正式发布”之后，基本上还是贝塞斯达式的，bug从轻微烦人到“因为这个♥♥♥♥♥♥♥的bug我不得不重开我60小时的存档”都有。而且战斗是我在这种游戏里见过最糟糕的之一。

让游戏不那么痛苦的想法：
-修复那个可怕的bug，它会让你无法实际建造任何东西，尽管你有工具和物品
-去掉烦人的加载启动画面（为什么非得点一下？直接加载就行了。）
-修复那糟糕透顶的卡顿/掉帧/冻结问题
-修复退出菜单后滚轮缩放的回弹问题
-修复糟糕的PDA文件界面
-修复重水容器生成率异常低的问题
-在文件菜单里明确标出哪个PDA是你的
-让警察在飞船应答器关闭时无法通缉你
-O2罐加满后自动关闭
-玩家放置的物品保持为玩家财产。（那是我的电池充电器，别因为我把它捡起来就逮捕我。）
-允许在拖拽船只时停靠空间站
-把飞船和空间站上的大多数容器设为私有财产，这样我就不能随便顺走别人的大麻烟了
-提供不用为了弄到火炬引擎而肝现实里好几天就能到达其他星球的不同方式
-更多太空恐怖
-在有轨电车式车站里加交通亭，这样我们就不是直接传送到空间站其他部分了
-某些NEOScavenger剧情线有更多进展
-减少繁琐的睡眠/超快跳过机制
-改进自动任务编码（不，我不想让你拿着空电钻站在那里，把你充满电的备用电池装进去！）

items.text:
It's a hit or miss kind of game that does a lot of cool things, but also has some issues.

I'll just get this out of the way but the game is a little pozzed. Just take a look at some character attributes, the fact the devs only have a Blusky account and the just the way the characters looks. A bit of a shame but it's ignorable for the most part, just think there's an unrealistic amount of a certain kind of people walking around these stations. I should have expected as much for anything published by Kitfox, but the games they publish are usually really great games with deep mechanics and systems. This game looked the same, and to a solid extent it is.

I quite enjoyed Blue Bottle's previous game, Neo Scavenger, especially for its excellent worldbuilding and writing. The same can be found in this title. The mechanics are just as intriguing if not more, and I'm always down for a space sim RPG game. I like the looting system (when it's not being buggy or clunky) and the shipbuilding and maintenance is fun and somewhat immersive. I also like how it portrays itself being dense and with lots to learn while being quite approachable in reality, if you just take a moment to follow the built in tutorial. That being said, this game feels unfinished.

Yes perhaps content-wise, it's complete, but the game is missing QoL and has some very annoyings bugs that especially makes the automation elements of this game perform poorly. I've repeatedly gotten a super annoying bug where my character decides to just cycle an empty battery from his inventory, to the ground and to a wall charger on my ship while under automation orders even after I've manually put a fresh, fully charged battery into the tool he was replacing the battery for. I've also had my character just straight up ignore his tasks to repair some random part rather than do the work he was supposed to do and had all the necessary components accessible for. Doing major time skips while you set your character to repair parts of the ship automatically doesn't seem to do anything. I've had moments where the game just decides certain cells in my inventory are no longer allowed to hold anything, and then fix itself later with no explanation. I'm not sure why I need a mod to assign an automated task to pick up items into a character's inventory. AI ships seems to travel at ridiculous speeds in space compared to you... And more.

There's just a lot of little things that make this game uncessarily frustrating. 这是一款时好时坏的游戏，做了很多很酷的事情，但也有一些问题。

我就直说了吧，这游戏有点被政治正确污染了。只要看看一些角色属性、开发者只有一个Blusky账号这个事实，还有角色的长相就知道了。有点遗憾，但大部分情况下可以忽略，只是想想这些空间站里走来走去的某类人数量多得不太现实。我本该料到Kitfox发行的东西会这样，但他们发行的游戏通常都是真正很棒的游戏，有着深度的机制和系统。这款游戏看起来也一样，而且在很大程度上确实如此。

我非常喜欢Blue Bottle的上一款游戏《Neo Scavenger》，尤其是它出色的世界观构建和写作。这款作品里也能找到同样的东西。机制同样引人入胜，甚至更胜一筹，而我一直都很喜欢太空模拟RPG游戏。我喜欢拾荒系统（当它没有出bug或笨拙的时候），造船和维护也很有趣，还有一定的沉浸感。我也喜欢它把自己表现得内容密集、有很多东西要学，但实际上相当平易近人，只要你花点时间跟着内置教程走。话虽如此，这游戏感觉没做完。

是的，也许在内容方面它是完整的，但游戏缺少生活质量改进，还有一些非常烦人的bug，尤其是让游戏的自动化元素表现得很差。我反复遇到一个超级烦人的bug：我的角色在自动化指令下，决定把一块空电池从他的物品栏里循环地拿到地上、再拿到飞船上的墙壁充电器上，即使我已经手动把一块全新的、充满电的电池放进了他正在更换电池的那个工具里。我还遇到过我的角色直接无视自己的任务，去修理某个随机的部件，而不是去做他本该做的工作——而且他本来就能拿到所有必要的组件。当你把角色设置为自动修理飞船部件时，进行大幅时间跳跃似乎什么也不做。我还遇到过游戏突然决定我物品栏里的某些格子不再允许存放任何东西，然后又莫名其妙地自己恢复正常。我不明白为什么我需要一个mod才能给角色分配一个自动拾取物品到物品栏的任务。AI飞船在太空中的飞行速度似乎快得离谱，跟你比起来……还有更多。

就是有很多小事情让这款游戏变得不必要地令人沮丧。在一款不那么耗时的游戏里，我或许可以忽略其中一些事情，但这款游戏非常慢，做很多事情都要花大量时间。自动化机制不是最好的，或者有bug，这让情况更糟。我觉得这是款好游戏，但只是被一些问题拖累了，我认为开发者需要解决这些问题。所以我不能给这款游戏点赞，尤其是它已经是1.0版本了却还是这种状态。

我提到的那些bug已经被修复了。

我三次开始新游戏，三次都在最开始的教学任务中遇到了导航面板恢复的bug。好吧，这还能忍，我搞明白了怎么从空间站飞出去，开始拆解那些废弃的太空日古利，但当我返回空间站时，它把我对接到了另一个气闸，而我打不开它。我无法获得脱离开的许可，因为我没有支付某些费用（？？）。但与此同时，我仍然可以通过导航面板飞到其他空间站和其他飞船那里，通过即时对接。

The most ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ space travel controls I've ever seen in a video game, my ship is sliding all over the place, and you have to manually dock your ship, which gets awfully tedious starting around the third time you do it.

No autopilot for your ships AFAIK, hopefully there are high-end ships with autopilot but from the vibes this game is giving off I don't find that very likely.

Also, you can take "gigs", which are something like paid quests, but you have to figure out where to go on your own. No compass, no quest marker, just a distance, which means you have to figure out what direction to go, which wouldn't be the end of the world, IF you weren't slipping and sliding like a moron all the time. It gets really hard to figure out where to go when you can't stay still and just move in one direction.

And if you click on the map during space travel, your map centers on whatever you click on, even empty space. But due to "realistic space physics", that point in space is moving. Or you're moving relative to it, I guess. Even when you're perfectly still. This isn't fun. This isn't useful. This is just realism bringing the experience of playing the game down. It means every time you accidentally click empty space, you have to pause the game, gradually and painstakingly click and drag your way back to your ship (all the while fighting the auto-centering mechanic) and click on it in order to focus back on it.

This is one of those games that probably takes you days, if not weeks, to fully learn, but learning how to play the game isn't fun at all, it's tedious and dull. I don't have the willpower to suffer through this learning curve hoping that MAYBE the game gets good and I can overlook the awful space travel system the game is essentially based around.

3/10

items.text:
If you're looking at this page, Ostranauts absolutely delivers on the experience you're looking for. The worldbuilding really puts you into the setting, and the core gameplay mechanics have you feeling like a proper spacer. Unfortunately, this is all marred by the absolutely atrocious state the game is in.

At its core, this is a game about inventory management. Both the size and shape of your ship is going to determine what types and what amounts of salvage you can bring aboard. External cargo netting is cheap, light, and quick to lay down, but accessing its inventory means donning a suit for a spacewalk. Underfloor storage bays are expensive, but they allow you to fit a large amount of salvage in a smaller, more convenient space that can even be pressurized. Unfortunately, they're also heavier, which means they have a more sizeable impact on your fuel and thrusters.

For all this, the actual tools the game has for inventory management are absolute garbage. It's 2026, and the game doesn't even have a "Deposit/Stack similar items" button for containers. Shift-clicking prefers to deposit items on the ground instead of the active container, which means you'll have to manually drag items into their proper containers, one by one. This is a game with 10 different types of scrap; all of which are needed for repairing various salvage. There is a host of various supplies you need to keep track of on your ship, and the game does nothing to help make it easier.

And then there's the bugs. So much of the UI seems to be either placeholder or so broken it doesn't even work. The "resume order" button which appears on every pending order has simply never worked for me; to force a character to manually do an assigned work order, you'll have to cancel the order, then start it up again from their specific menu. There is an entire menu for a task priority system, but it's all placeholder, as it doesn't actually do anything.

A good hazard should be either preventable or react-able. Having it be neither is what leads to frustrating gameplay. Fires are seemingly not preventable. A breathing environment that is 100% oxygen is highly combustible, so adding nitrogen to the mix will help reduce the chances of fires starting. Damaged electronics have a chance of malfunctioning and starting a fire, so keeping everything maintained is important. Unfortunately, doing any welding work has a chance of setting surrounding items on fire, regardless of environment or condition. Doing welding work on a wall can set fire to the perfectly maintained power line embedded in it. Doing welding work on a reactor core with nothing flammable in the room has a chance of your character setting their own pants on fire.

Fires are also not truly react-able. If you immediately respond to a fire by having everyone don their pressure/eva suits (which they keep in their inventories at all times for such emergencies), then begin using their fire extinguishers (which they also keep in their inventories at all times for such emergencies), while having someone immediately vent the ship to starve the fire & and pull out the smoke... everyone who was in the room now has chronic emphysema from smoke inhalation. The fact that fires are a hazard that are neither fully preventable nor react-able without permanent consequence is the reason why you can see every other recent negative review complaining about fires. This is on top of the fact that, like everything else in the game, fires give no feedback at all on what actually caused the fire, so new players will have an especially rough time figuring out what's going on.

Building ships is the epitome of the poor UI design in this game. The game has one menu for installing tiles & components, and a separate menu for every other order in the game. You can not pull both of these menus up at the same time. This means that if you need to undo a build order, you'll need to back out of the build menu and go into the orders menu to cancel it. 

There is also no option for selecting a palette or filtering out any of the build options. The game only has the bare minimum of separate categories (HVAC, Powergen, Hull Tiles, etc). This means that when you go back to the build menu, you've lost your place and have to find the tiles you were working with. These all seem like small nitpicks, but they're things that add up and build frustration with time. 

Speaking of small nitpicks, there is so much pointless micromanagement, and the game is prone to the kind of mistakes you only make because you're playing a video game. For some odd reason, left & right shoes are treated as separate entities instead of being bundled together. This adds nothing to the game. It's just 4 extra pointless clicks that can be another pain point if you, going through the motions, somehow manage to put the shoe on the wrong foot. If so, your character can develop painful blisters that slow down work/movement speed. Your character won't complain, so this can persist until you tab to them, wonder why they're in pain, then realize they have their shoes on the wrong feet. It feels like the video game equivalent of a pointless DM gotcha. This doesn't happen in real life. People don't usually just put their shoes on the wrong foot by accident and then deal with it until they get blisters on their feet.

Clothing management is an interesting system, but it's such a slog to actually go through. Casual clothes are comfortable and reduce filth gain. This is important, since crewmembers on break need to be comfortable to read skill books and generate increased filth if they're working out. Unfortunately, there's no uniform system, so, even on scheduled break time, characters won't switch back to their casual clothes by themselves. This leads to more pointless micro you have to do for every character you control.

God forbid a crewmember decide it's a good time to go for a 6-hour marathon after you forget to doff their eva suit (which increases filth gain). Characters are coded to automatically use hygiene packs when they get dirty, but if you run out (which you will, because the station doesn't stock enough), there is no option to allow them to automatically use the copious amounts of water you have for washing. There is no cap on filth, and no ability to queue tasks, so you can waste minutes just watching and retasking a character to wash themselves off with water instead of hygiene packs. The AI in general is a crapshoot, and constantly wastes your time with its problems.

The kicker is that a lot of these problems have persisted even after a "hardening phase" in which the developers focused on QoL and bugfixing.

This game desperately needs a QoL pass by someone with some proper UI/UX experience. There are also a lot of broken elements that simply aren't the sort of things you leave until the end to fix. Underneath all the dirt, there is an absolute gem of a game here. However, unless you're patient, have a lot of free time on your hands, and absolutely in love with the genre, I highly recommend waiting for the game to be in a more polished state.

I eagerly await the day I can change this review, but, until then, I've already been lead astray by other Early Access titles that have focused on constant content updates while leaving maintenance work by the wayside. More often than not, tech debt accumulates to the point where the developers decide to just release as-is; sometimes even starting work on a sequel with a "stronger base". I pray that Ostranauts can buck the trend, because there's a really good game underneath all the mess.
items.text_zh:
如果你正在看这个页面，那么 Ostranauts 绝对能提供你正在寻找的那种体验。世界观构建真正让你沉浸到设定之中，核心玩法机制让你感觉自己就是个正经的太空人。不幸的是，这一切都被游戏目前极其糟糕的状态给毁了。

从本质上讲，这是一款关于库存管理的游戏。你飞船的大小和形状将决定你能带上船的打捞物类型和数量。外部货网便宜、轻便、铺设迅速，但要访问它的库存就意味着得穿上宇航服进行太空行走。地板下的储物舱很昂贵，但它们能让你在更小、更方便甚至还能加压的空间里装下大量打捞物。不幸的是，它们也更重，这意味着它们对你的燃料和推进器有更显著的影响。

尽管如此，游戏实际用于库存管理的工具简直是垃圾。都2026年了，游戏甚至没有一个针对容器的“存入/堆叠同类物品”按钮。Shift点击更倾向于把物品放到地上而不是当前激活的容器里，这意味着你不得不手动把物品一个一个拖进它们该去的容器。这是一款有10种不同废料的游戏；而修复各种打捞物都需要用到它们。你船上有一大堆各种补给需要跟踪管理，而游戏完全不帮忙让它变得更容易。

然后就是bug。UI的很大一部分似乎要么是占位符，要么坏得根本不能用。每个待处理订单上出现的“恢复订单”按钮对我来说从来就没起过作用；要强迫一个角色手动执行分配的工作订单，你得先取消订单，然后从他们的专属菜单里重新启动它。有一个完整的任务优先级系统菜单，但全是占位符，因为它实际上什么都不做。

一个好的危险应该要么可预防，要么可应对。两者皆非正是导致令人沮丧的游戏体验的原因。火灾似乎无法预防。100%氧气的呼吸环境高度易燃，所以在混合气体中加入氮气有助于降低起火几率。受损的电子设备有几率发生故障并引发火灾，所以保持一切维护良好很重要。不幸的是，进行任何焊接工作都有几率点燃周围的物品，无论环境或状况如何。在一面墙上进行焊接工作可能会点燃嵌入其中维护得完美无缺的电线。在一个没有任何易燃物的房间里对反应堆核心进行焊接工作，有几率让你的角色把自己的裤子点着。

火灾也不是真正可应对的。如果你对火灾的立即反应是让所有人穿上他们的压力服/EVA服（他们为了这种紧急情况一直把这些放在自己的库存里），然后开始使用他们的灭火器（他们同样为了这种紧急情况一直把这些放在自己的库存里），同时让某人立即给飞船泄压以饿死火焰并排出烟雾……原本在那个房间里的每个人现在都因为吸入烟雾而患上了慢性肺气肿。火灾是一种既不能完全预防、也不能在无永久性后果的情况下应对的危险，这就是为什么你能看到其他每一条最近的负面评测都在抱怨火灾。除此之外，就像游戏里的其他一切一样，火灾完全不提供任何关于究竟是什么引发了火灾的反馈，所以新玩家会尤其艰难地搞不清楚到底发生了什么。

建造飞船是这款游戏糟糕UI设计的典型代表。游戏有一个用于安装地板砖和组件的菜单，而游戏里其他所有订单则有一个单独的菜单。你无法同时调出这两个菜单。这意味着如果你需要撤销一个建造订单，你得退出建造菜单，再进入订单菜单去取消它。

也没有选择调色板或过滤任何建造选项的功能。游戏只有最低限度的几个独立分类（暖通空调、发电、船体地板砖等）。这意味着当你回到建造菜单时，你已经丢失了原来的位置，不得不重新找到你之前正在处理的地板砖。这些看起来都像是小的吹毛求疵，但它们是会随着时间累积并滋生挫败感的东西。

说到小的吹毛求疵，游戏里有太多毫无意义的微观管理，而且游戏很容易犯那种你只因为是在玩电子游戏才会犯的错误。出于某种奇怪的原因，左脚鞋和右脚鞋被当作独立的实体，而不是捆绑在一起。这对游戏毫无增益。这只是多出4次毫无意义的点击，而且如果你在机械地操作时不知怎么把鞋穿错了脚，这还可能成为另一个痛点。如果穿错了，你的角色会起疼痛的水泡，从而减慢工作/移动速度。你的角色不会抱怨，所以这种情况可能会一直持续，直到你切到他们身上，纳闷他们为什么在疼痛，然后才意识到他们把鞋穿错了脚。这感觉就像是电子游戏版的毫无意义的DM陷阱。这在现实生活中不会发生。人们通常不会不小心把鞋穿错脚，然后一直忍着直到脚上起水泡。

服装管理是一个有趣的系统，但实际走一遍流程实在太累人了。休闲服舒适并能减少污垢积累。这很重要，因为休息中的船员需要舒适才能阅读技能书，而如果他们正在锻炼则会积累更多污垢。不幸的是，没有制服系统，所以即使是在预定的休息时间，角色也不会自己换回休闲服。这导致你不得不为你控制的每个角色做更多毫无意义的微观操作。

天哪，要是你忘了让某个船员脱下他们的EVA服（这会增加污垢积累），而他们决定这时候去跑个6小时马拉松，那可就糟了。角色的编码设定是当他们变脏时会自动使用卫生包，但如果你用完了（你一定会用完的，因为空间站储备不够），就没有选项允许他们自动使用你手头大量用于清洗的水。污垢没有上限，也没有排队任务的能力，所以你可能会浪费好几分钟就只是看着一个角色并重新指派他们用水而不是卫生包来清洗自己。AI总体来说就是一场赌博，不断用它的各种问题浪费你的时间。

最要命的是，很多这些问题即使在开发者专注于QoL和修bug的“加固阶段”之后依然存在。

这款游戏迫切需要由某个有正经UI/UX经验的人来做一次QoL优化。还有很多损坏的元素，根本不是那种你可以留到最后再修的东西。在所有这些污垢之下，这里有一款绝对堪称瑰宝的游戏。然而，除非你有耐心、手头有大把空闲时间、并且绝对热爱这个类型，否则我强烈建议等游戏进入更完善的状态再说。

items.text:
Sadly I can't recommend the game in its current state.

There are just to many bugs and the movement is very clunky, interrupting any game flow. For example, you can't queue actions and always have to quit actions manually before switching to another task.

Additionally, the devs don't really care about bugs. Instead, they choose to confront the players with random pop-ups of error messages. For example the camera rotation is dysfunctional while docking your ship. They could have fixed that, but instead they decide to let pop up annoying error messages, whenever one tries to rotate the world view.

This all leads to a tedious and frustrating gameplay.

此外，开发者并不真正关心bug。相反，他们选择用随机弹出的错误信息来面对玩家。例如，停靠飞船时相机旋转功能失灵。他们本可以修复它，却决定每当有人试图旋转世界视角时，就弹出烦人的错误信息。

items.text:
Media embodiment of autism. Clocked close to 50 hours within the first few days of playing this. Yet I've decided to put it down until it becomes more polished.

There is just this feeling with this game that the developers are so driven to create a complex system that they aren't focused to slow down and refine the individual core processes that are the pieces that bring that system alive.

They're soon to add ship-combat but how long can they keep putting systems together before it eventually just becomes too much? I would really suggest the developers to slow down a little and simply work out how to make the game more playable (the keyword being playable, not fun, nor complex - both it is - but playable).

A few core systems are lacking depth that pull you out of the game given how immersive it can be at times:
- mental status/social/relationships seem to have no real significant impact on gameplay; I rolled a smoker character. To light a cigarette you have to a) have cigarettes in the pack itself) b) action the pack of cigarettes to light a cigarette) c) put out the cigarette but dragging it from your mouth to the trash or on the floor - turns out if you're suffering a nicotine withdrawl it does little to actually affect your gameplay meaning you can simply select smoker for a free point and never smoke. 
- The UI is incredibly clunky and difficult to navigate; Why can't I pin my inventory to always be displayed? The game becomes a slog after you start to manage your needs alongside your crew and ship. Why can't I customise the UI features? I don't half my screen obscured by an event log when half the event log is fluff in itself. 
- variety of items (excluding ship items)

I don't know if this is a bug or not but I left items outside of the ship during a derelict run and when I docked at the station all the items were still where I left them but had somehow traveled half way across the star system without being in a cargoweb? I spent 15 minutes putting together a cargo web system on the backend to ensure I can carry more items to find out I can just game it by not doing so (which I refuse to do so but it just pulls you out when you know you can. It also turns out you can just use floor tiles to do so as well... Why bother with a cargo web item if you can just a) game the system, b) rip a floor off a ship your salvaging and always have storage - this gets to a point where you start to not worry about what you can take and can't take as you know you can just rip stuff apart and throw it on the back of your ship without any care or worry...

Further example... Docked my ship but forgot to turn off my proximity alarm. Time to now close down my menu, walk all the way back to my ship, right click the NAV centre - slot them in. Click the alarm. Make them get out of the seat. Walk all the way back. The feature of the proximity alarm is crucial to space travel - why can't there be a little toggle next to it in-it-self to toggle on and off upon docking? You can link your NAV console to your PDA - why can't I simply toggle it from my PDA? Or simply add a new PDA chip that allows you to do so? These little touches that would make it less of a chore.

I think this will hands down be the best simulator on the market once the time comes - but it's a matter of when, not if. 

I still highly recommend it - the above is simply feedback for the developers.
items.text_zh:
自闭症在媒体中的化身。在开始玩这款游戏的几天内，游戏时间就接近50小时。然而我决定先放下它，直到它变得更加完善。

这款游戏给人一种感觉：开发者如此执着于创建一个复杂的系统，以至于他们没有专注于放慢脚步，去打磨那些让整个系统活起来的各个核心流程。

他们很快就要加入飞船战斗，但在最终变得太多之前，他们还能把系统拼凑多久？我真的建议开发者放慢一点，简单地想办法让游戏更可玩（关键词是可玩，不是有趣，也不是复杂——这两者它都具备——而是可玩）。

有几个核心系统缺乏深度，考虑到游戏有时能如此沉浸，这会把你从游戏中拉出来：
- 精神状态/社交/关系似乎对玩法没有真正显著的影响；我随机了一个吸烟者角色。要点燃一支烟，你必须 a) 烟盒里本身有烟 b) 对烟盒执行动作来点燃一支烟 c) 熄灭香烟，但要把烟从嘴里拖到垃圾桶或地板上——结果发现，如果你正遭受尼古丁戒断，它实际上对玩法几乎没有影响，这意味着你可以直接选择吸烟者来白拿一个点数，然后永远不抽烟。
- UI极其笨重且难以操作；为什么我不能把物品栏固定为始终显示？当你开始同时管理自己的需求、船员和飞船时，游戏就变成了一件苦差事。为什么我不能自定义UI功能？我可不想半个屏幕被事件日志挡住，而事件日志本身有一半都是废话。
- 物品种类（不包括飞船物品）

我不知道这是不是bug，但我在一次废弃飞船探索中把物品留在了飞船外面，当我在空间站停靠时，所有物品都还在我留下的地方，却不知怎么在不在货网里的情况下穿越了半个星系？我花了15分钟在后端搭建了一个货网系统，以确保我能携带更多物品，结果发现我只要不这么做就能钻空子（我拒绝这么做，但当你知道自己可以这么做时，它就会把你从游戏中拉出来。结果还发现你只要用地板砖也能做到……如果你能 a) 钻系统空子，b) 从你正在打捞的飞船上拆下一块地板，然后永远都有存储空间，那还要货网物品干什么——这到了某个地步，你开始不再担心自己能拿什么、不能拿什么，因为你知道你可以随便把东西拆开，毫不在意、毫不担心地扔到飞船后面……

再举个例子……我把飞船停靠好了，但忘了关掉我的接近警报。现在得关掉我的菜单，一路走回我的飞船，右键点击导航中心——把它们放进去。点击警报。让它们从座位上起来。再一路走回去。接近警报这个功能对太空旅行至关重要——为什么不能在它旁边本身就有个小开关，在停靠时切换开和关？你可以把你的导航控制台连接到你的PDA——为什么我不能直接从我的PDA上切换它？或者干脆加一个新的PDA芯片让你能做到这一点？这些小小的细节会让它少很多麻烦。

我认为等到时机成熟，这毫无疑问会是市场上最好的模拟器——但问题是什么时候，而不是会不会。

我仍然强烈推荐它——以上只是给开发者的反馈。

items.text:
Fun but way too many bugs as of now, full of stuttering and other problems.
Turning off ceiling mode and pressing alt turns it back on, you need to go back to menus to turn it off again.
Zone designations barely work, sometimes drag clicking adds tiles to a zone, sometimes it does not, if a zone ends near a corner tile, there is a chance that your character will infinitely stack items on top of a wall tile.
Path finding is abysmall, the characters always choose the shortest path even though it might take 3x longer.
Some UI Elements seem to sometimes just flat out dissapear and not reappear until you reload the save.
The character needs menu does not work as intended, it might be 10% full but the tooltip says that the character is very tired, same goes with food and thirst.
Combat is very janky and unintuitive.
Very tedious to change out and recharge tool batteries when you are expanding your ship, not only the building itself is time consuming, navigating the inventories of rechargers and your tools is tedious.
You can rearrange your inventory bars... untill you close your inventory and once you open it up again, they are all in default spots, it might take up to half the screen if you have enough inventories on you.
You can hire crew and set their schedules, sadly the idiots refuse to sleep before you manually remove their helmets, what's the point of a schedule when you have to babysit each and every one of the crew?
Hauling command makes the game less tedious but is implemented poorly, the crew will deliver as many items at a time as many there are on a single floor tile, even though they could pick 20 nearby items and stash them in their inventory, they will rather take 20 trips than one.

Edit: tried it again Sept 16, 2026. Just give me my ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ money back. I couldn't get through the tutorial. Where is the "Nav station"? What do any of the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ starting traits even DO? Why am I clicking on any of these ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ things? What an utter piece of ♥♥♥♥ this "game" is.....


The short version: this game is a janky, broken mess that screams out for a quality-of-life pass. I deeply regret buying it, and a significant portion of my 16hrs of playtime were spent redoing things that broke, or just trying to figure out some very basic things. It's bad. Avoid.

Longer version: I love Hardspace: Shipbreaker. I love games where you can salvage and build. The salvaging and building part of the game is... fine. It functions. You can right click on a thing, click "uninstall", and your character uninstalls it. You can right-click a thing, click on "repair" or "restore" and they do that. You need a variety of tools to do these things, and some of them need power. Cool. All of this is great.

And then the wall of your (broken down) ship breaks due to wear and tear, and you need to repair it. Awesome! Some urgency! But... You can't repair the wall cause the cooler is in the way. Fine, fine, I'll just uninstall the cooler: done. Repair the wall? Easy. I'll just put the cooler back now... Oh... I can't install the cooler? In the spot where it just was? But... It was just there?

The placement grid is all translucent grey, so that means there's nothing in the way... But, of course, there can't be anything in the way because how else could the cooler have been where it was? How could I have uninstalled it if there were things in the way. Maybe I need to be able to access the outside of my ship?

A long, long time passes while I figure out how to safely access the outside of my ship: nope, still can't install the cooler.

Turns out that if you really, REALLY zoom all the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ way in, the corners of one of the placement squares *around* the cooler (note: not the cooler itself) is a very mild tinge of pink. Meaning there's an N2 canister in the way. But if the N2 canister is in the way of the install, how the ♥♥♥♥ did I UNinstall the cooler?

There are several times where I intentionally "dropped" a dolly (essentially a large shopping cart) and coudn't pick it back up. Why? Who ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ knows, the game sure isn't telling me.

If you drag a component you have legitimately salvaged into the station and start dismantling it in the public space, security will rush over and arrest you. Why? It's a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ mystery.

How does Character creation work? What do the choices *mean* in the context of the game? What does "skilled" mean? If I'm "5% training" in a skill, how much does the skill increase per relevant skill use? Also: what the ♥♥♥♥ do these skills enable? What do they DO? What do I need them for? In what way are they relevant? Why did dismantling a sleeping bag increase my ***structural engineering*** skill, ffs?

This is in addition to broken quests, and irrelevant things that just don't make any sense. For example, I received an SOS from an NPC ship who wanted fuel. Sure, sez I, and zipped over as quick as I could.
Me: "I'm requesting docking"
NPC: "♥♥♥♥ you, back off"

Um... What? The transponder call-sign matched the ship, but... They just preferred to drift in space.

You get random quest pop-ups: Some dude calls you and wants to talk, you should find and speak to him.
Me: Cool. Where is he.
Game: *shrug*
Me: ok, but he called me and asked to meet. Did he give me a ship name?
Game: *shrug*
Me: is he on this station?
Game: Nope.
Me: So....?
Game: ♥♥♥♥ you.

It's a broken janky mess that, I'm sure, will be fantastic in about 10 years from now. Right now, though? I'd be annoyed if I had only paid CA$5 for this, but pissed that I paid CA$20. (I'm normally a superfan of SplattercatGaming, but I really feel he misrepresented this one as being so much way better than it actually is)

编辑：2026年9月16日又试了一次。就把我的♥♥♥♥♥♥♥钱还给我吧。我连教程都过不去。“导航站”在哪里？那些♥♥♥♥♥♥♥初始特质到底有什么用？我为什么要点击这些♥♥♥♥♥♥♥东西？这个“游戏”真是一坨彻头彻尾的♥♥♥♥……


简短版：这游戏是个破破烂烂、漏洞百出的烂摊子，急需一次体验优化。我非常后悔买了它，我16小时的游戏时间里很大一部分都花在重做那些坏掉的东西上，或者只是试图搞明白一些非常基础的事情。它很烂。别买。

详细版：我喜欢《Hardspace: Shipbreaker》。我喜欢那种可以打捞和建造的游戏。这游戏的打捞和建造部分……还行。它能运转。你可以右键点击一个东西，点击“卸载”，你的角色就会把它卸下来。你可以右键点击一个东西，点击“修理”或“恢复”，它们就会那么做。你需要各种各样的工具来做这些事，其中一些还需要电力。酷。所有这些都很棒。

然后你那艘（破败的）飞船的墙壁因为磨损而破裂了，你需要修理它。太棒了！有点紧迫感！但是……你没法修墙，因为冷却器挡道了。行吧行吧，我先把冷却器卸下来：搞定。修墙？简单。我现在把冷却器装回去……哦……我装不上冷却器？就在它刚才所在的位置？但是……它刚才就在那儿啊？

放置网格全是半透明的灰色，所以那意味着没有东西挡道……但是，当然不可能有东西挡道，不然冷却器怎么可能在它原来的位置？如果有东西挡道，我怎么可能把它卸下来。也许我需要能够接触到飞船的外部？

过了很长很长一段时间，我终于搞明白如何安全地接触到飞船外部：不行，还是装不上冷却器。

结果发现，如果你真的、真的把视角♥♥♥♥♥♥♥拉到最近，冷却器*周围*的某个放置方格（注意：不是冷却器本身）的角上有一丝非常轻微的粉色。意思是有一个N2罐挡道了。但如果N2罐挡住了安装，那我♥♥♥♥到底是怎么把冷却器卸下来的？

有好几次我故意“丢下”一辆推车（基本上就是一个大购物车），然后就捡不回来了。为什么？谁♥♥♥♥♥♥♥知道，游戏肯定没告诉我。

如果你把一个合法打捞来的部件拖进空间站，然后在公共区域开始拆解它，保安会冲过来逮捕你。为什么？这是个♥♥♥♥♥♥♥谜。

角色创建是怎么运作的？那些选择在游戏语境下*意味着*什么？“熟练”是什么意思？如果我在某个技能上有“5%训练”，那么每次相关技能使用时技能会提升多少？还有：这些技能到底♥♥♥♥能解锁什么？它们*做*什么？我需要它们干什么？它们在哪些方面相关？为什么拆一个睡袋会提升我的***结构工程***技能，我靠？

这还不算那些坏掉的任务，以及那些毫无意义、根本说不通的东西。比如，我收到一艘NPC飞船的求救信号，他们想要燃料。当然，我说，然后以最快速度飞了过去。
我：“我请求对接”
NPC：“♥♥♥♥你，退后”

呃……什么？应答器呼号跟那艘船是匹配的，但是……他们就是宁愿在太空里漂着。

你会随机收到任务弹窗：某个家伙打电话给你想谈谈，你应该找到他并跟他说话。
我：酷。他在哪。
游戏：*耸肩*

游戏：*耸肩*
我：他在这个空间站上吗？
游戏：不在。
我：所以……？

这是个破破烂烂的烂摊子，我相信，大概10年后它会变得非常棒。但现在呢？如果我只为它花了5加元，我会恼火，但我花了20加元，我很生气。（我通常是SplattercatGaming的超级粉丝，但我真的觉得他把这款游戏说得比实际好太多了）

items.text:
NOT playable without extreme frustration. time-waste, UI fatigue, and outright game-breaking problems right now.  As of now, I've thrown up my hands and given up on trying to get this to work.  70-80% of my gameplay time was spent fighting with an extremely user-hostile UI, whether in terms of inventory management or of trying to keep my crewmembers' psychology from constantly, rapidly degrading by extended periods of micromanaged abstract social interaction.

There are some very, very serious flaws in this game that make it almost-unplayable right now and have to be fixed very badly, even for the standards of early access.  I will check out the game later and hope the developer will address them decisively.  For now, though, my recommendation remains an unqualified, resounding NO for everyone.

(1) Dollies and other containers need to be able to be picked up ALWAYS.  I should never have to spend 30 minutes trying to figure out how to get around the "Can't get to The Tetsudo 'SuperHandy' Equipment truck" when my guy is standing right, next, to, it.  This happens constantly and is a major detractor, and on top of that is so unnecessary.  I don't care how many items are piled in that space.  If you make it possible, make it workable.  Fix it, right away.  It's a serious downer.

(2) I really need my guy to STOP walking away on his own when I'm trying to do something.  Doesn't matter what shift, but even on work shift he's constantly, walking, away.  I don't need to constantly herd ADD cats or micromanage their attention.  And never mind crewmembers.  AI behavior should only engage when it's set to AI.  Otherwise I don't want to be constantly fighting the insistent AI for control of my guys.  It's very frustrating and destroys enjoyment.  Fix this.

(3) Crewmember hyper-sensitivity (and inclination to quit) should be turned off until AI is more reliable.  I don't need to be rescuing my non-EVA-suited member from asphyxiation as they inexplicably leave the station to sit in the middle of my atmospherically-compromised beginning ship and then seeing this hit their Autonomy, after which I tediously have to complain about authorities over and over with them to get their Autonomy up, all while fighting their constantly walking away or doing other things and having to wait for them to randomly write a letter home.  Oh, and two other people coming and interrupting and having to wait for that to finish.  This is not gameplay; this is punishment, and it's excrutiating.

I get that you're trying to introduce an awareness and mechanical relevance of the non-instrumentality and needs of human beings as crew, for the respect of labor and its relationship to its employers, and that is laudable for sure, but it is pretty damned punishing and tedious right now.

As I write this, I watched my crewmember's Autonomy drop from green to Opprressed in a matter of minutes.  Wtf?  He'll quit momentarily no doubt, even though he's basically just come off of a two-day break after a day of work.  Guess I shouid just consider crewmembers untenable at this stage of development.

REMOVE this until it can work reasonably.  OR give an easily-accessible debug reset of crewmembers' psych condition so we don't have to spend 50% of playtime fighting with it.

4) Animation-locking for UI elements (like navigation console) and opening inventory on items MUST go.  It's a cardinal sin in a game with this much tedious micro to have every step be locked down in 2-3-second delays by animations no doubt intended to be immersive, but resulting in incrementing UI fatigue.  It's far worse when you have to wait to get in control of the ship because of some UI gaffe.  Don't make me "cancel" the "action" of not-doing-an-action so I can do the action.  (Yes, there's literally a timed, animation-locking action that characters frequently do that is "wait for..." -- a non-action that has to be manually canceled.) 
 Get rid of this.

Other significant but not-as-urgent problems:

1) Loading/saving (and pretty much everything else) needs to permit alt-tab out so we don't have to sit there staring at a load screen that takes 20 seconds before we even see a gameplay tip.


2) Default command keys are bizarre.  Tab should be switching between crew.  CAPS LOCK is a strange choice.  By virtue of the soul-crushing tendency of crewmembers to do stupid ♥♥♥♥ when they shouldn't, I have to switch between crewmembers a LOT to keep them on track; it should have the more conventional switch key.

3) Pressing TAB to switch between characters causes LOADING SHIP on-screen display and 2-3-second delay even if they're on the same ship, right next to each other.

TL:DR: Just read the top two paragraphs.

Note to dev: The real sin in a lot of this is you canNOT force-implement non-working systems.  If the psychology/morale system doesn't work sufficiently to be reasonably playable, either leave it turned off until you have developed it sufficiently, or allow players to disable it.  This was the straw that broke the camel's back for me.

EDIT 2025-05-24: I see the dev is pushing out updates, and that's an encouraging site.  Just waiting for an excuse to turn this review positive -- I do love a lot of what's trying to be done here and will be watching and waiting.

没有极度的挫败感就玩不下去。浪费时间、UI疲劳，而且眼下还有彻底破坏游戏的问题。就目前而言，我已经举手投降，放弃让它正常运转的尝试了。我70-80%的游戏时间都花在和一个极度不友好的UI作斗争上，无论是在库存管理方面，还是在试图通过长时间微观管理的抽象社交互动来防止我的船员心理不断、迅速地恶化方面。

这款游戏有一些非常、非常严重的缺陷，使其现在几乎无法游玩，而且必须非常迫切地修复，即使以抢先体验的标准来看也是如此。我以后会再看看这款游戏，并希望开发者能果断地解决这些问题。不过就目前而言，我的推荐仍然是对所有人毫无保留、响亮的“不”。

(1) 手推车和其他容器必须始终能够被拾取。我绝不应该花30分钟试图弄清楚如何绕过“无法到达Tetsudo‘SuperHandy’设备卡车”，而我的角色就站在它正、旁、边。这种情况不断发生，是一个主要的减分项，而且除此之外还完全没有必要。我不在乎那个空间里堆了多少物品。如果你让它成为可能，就让它可用。马上修好它。这非常令人扫兴。

(2) 我真的很需要我的角色在我试图做某事时停止自行走开。不管是什么班次，但即使在工作班次，他也一直在走开。我不需要不断驱赶患有注意力缺陷多动障碍的猫，也不需要微观管理它们的注意力。更不用说船员了。AI行为应该只在设置为AI时才启用。否则我不想不断与固执的AI争夺对我角色的控制权。这非常令人沮丧，并破坏乐趣。修好这个。

(3) 在AI更可靠之前，应该关闭船员的过度敏感（以及辞职倾向）。我不需要去拯救我没穿EVA服的船员免于窒息，因为他们莫名其妙地离开空间站，坐在我那大气环境受损的初始飞船中间，然后看到这影响了他们的自主性，之后我又得乏味地一遍又一遍和他们抱怨当局来提高他们的自主性，同时还要对抗他们不断走开或做其他事情，并不得不等他们随机给家里写信。哦，还有另外两个人过来打断，还得等那结束。这不是游戏玩法；这是惩罚，而且令人痛苦不堪。

我明白你是在试图引入对人类作为船员所具有的非工具性和需求的意识与机制相关性，出于对劳动的尊重及其与雇主的关系，这当然值得称赞，但现在这实在太惩罚人、太乏味了。

在我写这段话时，我看着我的船员的自主性在几分钟内从绿色降到“受压迫”。搞什么？他毫无疑问马上就会辞职，尽管他基本上才刚在工作一天后休完两天假。看来在这个开发阶段，我就该把船员视为不可用。

在它能合理运作之前，移除这个。或者提供一个易于访问的调试重置船员心理状态的功能，这样我们就不必把50%的游戏时间花在与它作斗争上。

4) UI元素（如导航控制台）的动画锁定以及打开物品库存的动画锁定必须取消。在一款有这么多乏味微观管理的游戏里，让每一步都被2-3秒的延迟锁住，是弥天大罪。
毫无疑问，这些动画本意是营造沉浸感，但结果却不断累积UI疲劳。当你因为某些UI失误而不得不等待才能控制飞船时，情况就更糟了。别让我为了做一个动作而不得不“取消”那个“不做动作”的“动作”。（是的，字面意义上存在一个定时的、锁定动画的动作，角色经常做，叫做“等待……”——一个必须手动取消的非动作。）
把这种东西去掉。

其他重要但没那么紧急的问题：

1）加载/保存（以及几乎所有其他操作）需要允许alt-tab切出，这样我们就不必坐在那里盯着一个要花20秒才显示游戏提示的加载画面。


2）默认命令键很奇怪。Tab应该用来在船员之间切换。CAPS LOCK是个奇怪的选择。由于船员们有一种令人心力交瘁的倾向，会在不该做蠢事的时候做蠢事，我不得不非常频繁地在船员之间切换以让他们保持正轨；它应该用更常规的切换键。

3）按TAB在角色之间切换会导致屏幕上显示LOADING SHIP并出现2-3秒的延迟，即使他们在同一艘飞船上，就紧挨着彼此。

TL:DR：只读前两段就行。

给开发者的备注：这其中很多问题的真正罪过在于，你绝不能强行实装不能正常运作的系统。如果心理/士气系统运作得不够好，无法合理可玩，要么在充分开发之前把它关掉，要么允许玩家禁用它。这就是压垮我的最后一根稻草。

编辑 2025-05-24：我看到开发者正在推送更新，这是个令人鼓舞的景象。只是在等一个把这条评测改成好评的借口——我确实很喜欢这里尝试做的很多事，会持续关注和等待。

[i]Very[/i] unfriendly tutorial. I was excited my the idea of this game but there's so much visual noise immediately. My feedback would be to lock away some of the complexity and drip feed it to a new player. 

The concept is so nice and I imagine once you have a deep understanding of everything, it's probably enjoyable. 
But most new players will likely be put off by the first 30 minutes, as I was. 

I felt there was a depth of play available but it was concealed behind a lot of frustrating elements.

Couple of other bits of feedback. The click to select on the Nav Station doesn't feel user friendly. Click and drag should be considered movement, clicking to move the frame was confusing. Especially as it kept locking the camera back to the crosshairs. It's also really not apparent which is your ship to a new player, in relation to anything. 
Names of things are also hidden if scrolled out, so it took a while to realise ONKG (sp) was hidden under a stack of names of things. Could be solved through a stack display accessible through hover or click of the mouse.

items.text:
>>> TLDR: This is a comprehensive set of systems to simulate space-scrapper's life with very little motivation to actually do it. It's also extremely clunky, filled with questionable mechanics and technical solutions, with a lot of esoteric systems that either need a Wiki open or make no sense regardless. This game has huge playability issues and Steam achievements' percentages reflect it justfully <<<

**Review after 1.0**
Thankfully, they improved technical state of the game. There are less bugs, the game stores its save files in the memory to minimize disk access times, game stutters way less, etc. However, player experience is still absolutely horrible (which is confirmed by achievements percentages). UI is awful (you can't even leave character creation menu), auto-tasking doesn't work properly half of the time, hauling is laughably inefficient (you haul one item at a time regardless of your inventory space and there is no *reasonable* item filtering system), pathfinding still completely fails beyond certain distance, controlling multiple characters is still a chore, super fast forward is better but still unreliable.

The worst thing about this game is badly designed game loop. It's more of a "game half-circle". You start with a debt, you can completely cover it in 3-5 game days and then money loose most of their value. Sure, you can buy some expensive real estate, but what's the point of this if your real estate is already docked to the station? Sure, you can buy some ship components from a vendor, but what's the point of this if the stock is random and the amount of hull parts is minuscule? Okay, instead of selling the components you can expand your ship. Cool. But it quickly hits practical limit and becomes purely an aesthetical activity (which is discouraging, because the process is very tedious and involves a lot of idle waiting). You can trade. Okay, but money don't really matter. You can flip ships. Nice, but there's not many uses for money. You can do high-paying missions. But they're repetitive and money aren't needed. In short, a lot of the game revolves around earning money, but money have almost no value past the very start of the game. Mods partially alleviate some of the issues but they can't fix game's core.



**Previous pre-release review** 
Don't look at my hour counter please, I played well over 100 hours of this game.
Overall, it's a great framework with functional simulations of a space scrapper's life and hazards. It needs more content, but mechanics are very solid, if a little bit intimidating to learn at first. And developer promised more content to come, so it's all good.

However. On the technical side game has multiple issues that are mainly the reason why this review is negative, unfortunately. 
- First of all, performance. Large ships lag a lot. Large amounts of NPCs lag a lot. The older the save, the more laggy it becomes. You *have* to use dev tools to debloat your save from time to time to keep game's performance adequate.
- Pathfinding. NPCs can't pathfind very well and can't pathfind at all beyond certain distance. Pathfinding between two ships can also be a challenge depending on both ships' sizes. This makes managing a crew or bulding up your ship a chore. You have to babysit crewmates at all times and make sure nobody is idling.
- Saves. This game juggles around a lot of data. It stores everything in JSON format, creating a separate file for every "ship" entity in the game, and packs each save in it's own archive. Due to how fractured saves are, they take a while to pack and unpack, which makes loading and saving the game take a while, even on a SSD. The game also doesn't save in a "quick" way, each save it goes over every single bit of data and creates new archive. It's taxing not only on player's time, but also on SSD's health. Game also allows a lot of garbage to accumulate on an older save, which includes all of the ships that flew outside of NPC salvagers' range of operations. On older save there could be dozens of pirate vessels drifting away to outer space which game has to account for. 
- Bugs. Every patch a lot of bugs get ironed out, yes, but there are still a lot of them present and very apparent. Ships can get stuck, NPCs can go to 4th dimension, constantly trying to pathfind out of it and eating away at performance, UI can break, shifts can break, super fast forward is unpredictable and unreliable, quests can break, etc.

If you can ignore all of the aforementioned issues, you can get a lot of fun out of Ostranauts. But I really want the developers to go over technical side of the game, because it's the weakest and the most crucial part of the experience in my opinion.
items.text_zh:
>>> 太长不看：这是一套全面的系统，用来模拟太空拾荒者的生活，但几乎没有真正去做的动力。它还极其笨拙，充斥着可疑的机制和技术方案，有大量晦涩难懂的系统，要么需要开着 Wiki，要么无论如何都说不通。这款游戏有巨大的可玩性问题，Steam 成就的百分比公正地反映了这一点 <<<

**1.0 之后的评测**
谢天谢地，他们改善了游戏的技术状态。Bug 更少了，游戏把存档文件存在内存中以尽量减少磁盘访问时间，游戏卡顿少多了，等等。然而，玩家体验仍然绝对糟糕（成就百分比证实了这一点）。UI 很糟糕（你甚至无法离开角色创建菜单），自动任务有一半时间不能正常工作，搬运效率低得可笑（无论你的库存空间有多大，你一次只能搬一件物品，而且没有*合理的*物品过滤系统），寻路在超过一定距离后仍然完全失效，控制多个角色仍然是一件苦差事，超级快进更好了但仍然不可靠。

这款游戏最糟糕的地方是设计糟糕的游戏循环。它更像是一个“游戏半圆”。你一开始背负债务，可以在 3-5 个游戏日内完全还清，然后钱就失去了大部分价值。当然，你可以买一些昂贵的房地产，但如果你的房地产已经停靠在空间站上，这又有什么意义呢？当然，你可以从供应商那里买一些飞船部件，但如果库存是随机的，而且船体部件的数量少得可怜，这又有什么意义呢？好吧，与其卖掉部件，你可以扩建你的飞船。很酷。但它很快就会触及实际限制，变成纯粹的美学活动（这令人沮丧，因为过程非常繁琐，涉及大量空闲等待）。你可以贸易。好吧，但钱并不真的重要。你可以倒卖飞船。不错，但钱没有多少用处。你可以做高报酬的任务。但它们重复性高，而且不需要钱。简而言之，游戏的大部分内容都围绕着赚钱，但在游戏刚开始之后，钱几乎没有任何价值。Mod 部分缓解了一些问题，但无法修复游戏的核心。



**之前的抢先体验评测**
请不要看我的小时数，我玩这款游戏远远超过 100 小时。
总体而言，这是一个很棒的框架，功能性地模拟了太空拾荒者的生活和危险。它需要更多内容，但机制非常扎实，尽管一开始学习起来有点吓人。而且开发者承诺会有更多内容，所以一切都好。

然而。在技术方面，游戏有多个问题，不幸的是，这些主要是这篇评测为负面的原因。
- 首先是性能。大型飞船会严重卡顿。大量 NPC 会严重卡顿。存档越旧，就越卡。你*必须*时不时使用开发者工具来精简你的存档，以保持游戏性能足够。
- 寻路。NPC 寻路能力很差，超过一定距离就完全无法寻路。根据两艘飞船的大小，在两艘飞船之间寻路也可能是个挑战。这使得管理船员或建造飞船成为一件苦差事。你必须时刻照看船员，确保没人在闲置。
- 存档。这款游戏要处理大量数据。它以 JSON 格式存储所有内容，为游戏中的每个“飞船”实体创建一个单独的文件，并将每个存档打包
放在它自己的存档里。由于存档碎片化严重，打包和解包需要一段时间，这使得加载和保存游戏都要花上一阵子，即使是在固态硬盘上也是如此。游戏也不是以“快速”方式保存的，每次保存都会遍历每一个数据位并创建新存档。这不仅消耗玩家的时间，也消耗固态硬盘的寿命。游戏还允许大量垃圾在旧存档中积累，其中包括所有飞出NPC打捞者作业范围之外的飞船。在旧存档中，可能有数十艘海盗船漂向外太空，而游戏必须对它们进行追踪处理。
- Bug。没错，每个补丁都会修掉很多bug，但仍然存在大量bug，而且非常明显。飞船可能卡住，NPC可能进入第四维度，不断尝试寻路脱离并消耗性能，UI可能崩溃，轮班可能崩溃，超级快进不可预测且不可靠，任务可能崩溃，等等。

如果你能忽略上述所有问题，你可以从《Ostranauts》中获得很多乐趣。但我真的希望开发者能好好处理游戏的技术层面，因为在我看来，这是整个体验中最薄弱、也最关键的部分。

[strike]Game is unplayable due to graphic glitches, could not play like 2 hours without crashing 5 times. UI freezes, while the rest keeps running, or I got the green screen, total system crash. 

I could see where this is going, and could be a very good game, but not ready yet for early access as it is so broken. I am thinking on refund but actually I want this game in a playable condition, so maybe half year later...[/strike]

[strike]Update: as of 2025 January, Still unplayable due to graphical negligence. Starts at 640*480 like we were in the '90-s, does not save proper resolution, goes back to low res. Clicks often fail, like clicking on menus just do nothing, then UI fully freezes. All the time, after 5-30 minutes. They probably do not test on AMD hardware. 

Shoddy work, should have refunded.

Update: 2025 end of april. Still unplayable due to graphics glitching and crashes. Is this a scam or developer so ignorant to blocker issues?[/strike]

Update: 2026 beginning of april, on the  public beta branch. Took like 1.5 years, but the game seems to be playable now. Great! The tutorial is still  broken, just stops guideance after the docking on the first derelict. Maybe I can remove the thumbsdown soon. At least I can now strike through the first part telling this would be unplayable. 

So, after 1.5 years I am finally able to review this.

Like
- Like the distopic asthetic. Everything is  dirty, worn. 
- Pretty detailed item  mechanics: power tools, with rechargeable or alkaline batteries.
- Many-many items: tools, wears, add-in cards, components
- Interesting and unique character creation including pre-game education and adventures.  Except the unnecessary woke things. 
- interesting flying mechanic. Quite lame with the 2D model and no computer autopilot, but using the consoles and the sounds still make it fun
- Full survival factor, with needs like food, water, cigarette, sleep, temperature, hygiene.
- Atmosphere simulation. You need proper airlock or the ship loses atmosphere... and your life. 
- Fun situations.. like I was dragging a heavy stuff on my ships patched hull and the patch flew off, and the ship was suddenly open to the space. 
- Deep gameplay mechanics like you find a body and open a case and start searching clues to provide justice.


Dislike
- I felt scammed for 1.5 years. This was ridiculously badly tested. Literally the WORST I ever bought, no other game was unplayable ever. I know people still could play it, seen youtubers. Probably hardware dependent, but I could not. Crashed like within minutes, it was so badly and carelessly designed / tested.
- Unnecessary woke aspects.
- The main loop seems odd. Why I need to spend so much time to repair the things I sell? Repair used to be an intermediate addition in the game loop to increase profit. However it is fun to repair my ship. 
- Starter ship should NOT be a randomly assigned pre-career thing. It should be selected at a kiosk at the station.
- Some starter ships are soo unusable, which would not be a problem if it wasn not randomly selected. I dragged a nav console and a few tanks then that is it, no more space, need to go sell them. There should be at least a few racks to hold the jumpsuit, food, unneded tools while salvaging and more cargo space.
- Space ships make electricity, batteries for emergencies only. There should a middle ground between battery and fusion reactor,  like fuel cells at least that takes h2 and o2 and has more endurance than battery.
- Kiosks are lame. No search, hard to find things. By default it wants to dend to barter zone.. so I bouht a coverall and 2 shooes, accidentally not dechecked the barter zone, 1 shoe is missing. It is somewhere on the ship.. seriously? Same happened when the lame auto-get-things-for-repair threw coverall pieces all over tthe ship and switched to spacesuit, I was searching for than damn shoe.
- Spacesuits are lame. It could have been awesome, but someone made it intentionally annoying. There is the pressure suit, it does not have O2 tank and CO2 filter, so you  go back and forth to refill the air inside the suit. Then there is the EVA suit, which has battery, O2 tank and CO2 filter.  But  it has a backpack piece, so you  carry the backpack or a crate in hand. 
- Item storage seems intentionally annoying. You have a rack on the ship, literally a tall  1 tile furniture, which hold 3 slots. Then  a backpack, that holds 16. Why? Wold it be painful to provide some space on the racks? like 32 slots per tile.
- Order / autotask / auto-get-things-for-repair is lame, buggy, annoying, total disaster. Lets say, I want to repair something, it needs parts, character will go collect one part, install it and go pick 1 part again.. one by one instead picking into the backpack. Order something to do... if the character finds an excuse why not to do, immediately starts doing something else. Autotask (do whatever you want) and queue (do these things I want you to do) should be different mechanics. 
- No shower? There is every game mechanic there to support it. No anymation needed, just a blacked out from top object where the character could shower in privacy. 
- Prox alert is annoying. It docking clamp engagement should auto-disable it since the ship is  not flying anymore. No point to annoyingly beep on the station. I know I can mute it, and I also know what happens when I  mute it and forget it. 
- The meat  could have been an interesting quest... but it is actually ridiculous. [spoiler]The hidden cultist/scientist/zealot stat is lame. Build an altar to teleport to a mythic monster? What the hell. Started as an experiment failure creating an uncontrollably growing meat blob.. then the goat monster and goat altar, totally unginged. Could have been clues leading to a distant derelict where a crazy scientist was experimenting with goat meat growing and planting specimen to other derelicts. Then the protagonist kills the scientist or helps him. Killing would stop the infection and acquire the weapon, helping would yield the meat grower. [/spoiler]
- Station NPC-s are lame. This is particularly annoying, since every game mechanic is there, they walk around and maintian the station. In spacesuits!! Why? They should be waling in coveralls, its pressurized. Or at least take the helpet off. 
- Station side quests are lame. I have like 10 of them, none doable. Some requires to talk to someone does not even exist in the social app, no idea where they are. No option to ask npc-s where certain people are. Others want me to beat up someone on the station.. then go to jail? 

So bottom line, finally I can thumbs this up, no longer unusable, yeeei! Stilll far from a hardcore space sim... come on, it flyes in 2D and speceship systems complexity is like kindergarten level. This is not hardcore, but hard to handle due to lame task queue system. Reentry, boy that is hardcore unit of a game.  Very good idea, good asthetics design, but lacking systems design, and very bad graphical programming, given that I could not play this so far.

[strike]由于图形故障，游戏无法游玩，玩了大约2小时就崩溃了5次。UI会冻结，而其他部分仍在运行，或者我遇到绿屏，整个系统崩溃。

我能看出这游戏的发展方向，可能会是一款非常好的游戏，但作为抢先体验版还远未准备好，因为它太破碎了。我在考虑退款，但实际上我希望这款游戏能达到可玩状态，所以也许半年后再说……[/strike]

[strike]更新：截至2025年1月，由于图形方面的疏忽，仍然无法游玩。启动时是640*480分辨率，就像我们还在90年代一样，无法保存正确的分辨率，会回到低分辨率。点击经常失败，比如点击菜单毫无反应，然后UI完全冻结。一直如此，在5-30分钟后。他们可能没有在AMD硬件上测试。

粗制滥造的工作，本该退款的。

更新：2025年4月底。由于图形故障和崩溃，仍然无法游玩。这是骗局，还是开发者对阻塞性问题如此无知？[/strike]

更新：2026年4月初，在公开测试分支上。花了大约1.5年，但游戏现在似乎可以玩了。太好了！教程仍然有问题，在第一次对接废弃飞船后就停止引导了。也许我很快就能取消差评。至少我现在可以把第一部分说这游戏无法游玩的内容划掉了。

所以，1.5年后我终于能够评价这款游戏了。

喜欢
- 喜欢这种反乌托邦美学。一切都脏兮兮、破旧不堪。
- 相当详细的物品机制：电动工具，配有可充电或碱性电池。
- 非常非常多的物品：工具、服装、扩展卡、组件
- 有趣且独特的角色创建，包括游戏前的教育和冒险。除了那些不必要的觉醒东西。
- 有趣的飞行机制。2D模型且没有电脑自动驾驶，相当蹩脚，但使用控制台和音效仍然让它很有趣
- 完整的生存要素，有食物、水、香烟、睡眠、温度、卫生等需求。
- 大气模拟。你需要正确的气闸，否则飞船会失去大气……以及你的生命。
- 有趣的情境……比如我在飞船修补过的船体上拖拽重物，补丁飞掉了，飞船突然向太空敞开。
- 深度的游戏机制，比如你发现一具尸体，打开一个箱子，开始搜寻线索以伸张正义。


不喜欢
- 我感觉被骗了1.5年。这测试得糟糕得离谱。简直是我买过的最差劲的，没有其他游戏曾经无法游玩。我知道有些人仍然能玩，看过youtuber玩。可能取决于硬件，但我不能。几分钟内就崩溃，设计/测试得如此糟糕和粗心。
- 不必要的觉醒方面。
- 主循环似乎很奇怪。为什么我需要花这么多时间修理我卖的东西？修理曾经是游戏循环中增加利润的中间环节。不过修理我的飞船很有趣。
- 初始飞船不应该是一个随机分配的职业生涯前的东西。它应该在空间站的售货亭选择。
- 有些初始飞船实在太不可用了，如果不是随机选择的话这不会是个问题。我拖了一个导航控制台和几个罐子，然后就这样了，没有更多空间，需要去卖掉它们。至少应该有几个架子来存放连体服、食物、打捞时不需要的工具，以及更多的货物空间。
- 太空飞船发电，电池仅用于紧急情况。电池和聚变反应堆之间应该有一个中间地带，比如至少燃料电池，消耗氢气和氧气，比电池有更长的续航。
- 
售货亭很烂。没有搜索功能，很难找到东西。默认情况下它想送到以物易物区……所以我买了一件连体工作服和2只鞋，不小心没有取消勾选以物易物区，1只鞋不见了。它在飞船上的某个地方……说真的？同样的事情发生在那个烂透了的自动获取修理物品功能把连体工作服碎片扔得满飞船都是并切换到太空服时，我当时就在找那只该死的鞋。
- 太空服很烂。本来可以很棒，但有人故意把它弄得烦人。有压力服，它没有氧气罐和二氧化碳过滤器，所以你得来回给服内的空气充气。然后有EVA服，它有电池、氧气罐和二氧化碳过滤器。但它有一个背包部件，所以你得背着背包或手里拿着箱子。
- 物品存储似乎故意让人烦。你在飞船上有一个架子，字面上一格高的家具，能放3个槽位。然后一个背包，能放16个。为什么？在架子上提供一些空间会痛苦吗？比如每格32个槽位。
- 订单/自动任务/自动获取修理物品很烂，有bug，烦人，彻底的灾难。比如说，我想修理某样东西，它需要零件，角色会去收集一个零件，安装它，然后再去拿1个零件……一个一个地拿，而不是装进背包。命令做某事……如果角色找到借口不做，就立刻开始做别的事。自动任务（做你想做的任何事）和队列（做这些我想让你做的事）应该是不同的机制。
- 没有淋浴？所有游戏机制都在那里支持它。不需要任何动画，只需要一个从顶部遮挡的物体，角色可以在那里私密地淋浴。
- 接近警报很烦人。对接夹接合应该自动禁用它，因为飞船不再飞行了。在空间站上烦人地哔哔叫没有意义。我知道我可以静音它，我也知道当我静音它然后忘记时会发生什么。
- 肉本来可以是一个有趣的任务……但实际上很荒谬。[剧透]隐藏的邪教徒/科学家/狂热者属性很烂。建造一个祭坛传送到一个神话怪物？搞什么鬼。开始是一个实验失败，创造了一个无法控制地生长的肉团……然后是山羊怪物和山羊祭坛，完全没解释。本来可以是线索指向一个遥远的废弃飞船，那里一个疯狂的科学家在实验山羊肉的生长，并把样本种植到其他废弃飞船上。然后主角杀死科学家或帮助他。杀死会阻止感染并获得武器，帮助会得到肉生长器。[/剧透]
- 空间站NPC很烂。这特别烦人，因为每个游戏机制都在那里，他们四处走动并维护空间站。穿着太空服！！为什么？他们应该穿着连体工作服走动，那里是加压的。或者至少把头盔摘下来。
- 空间站支线任务很烂。我有大约10个，没有一个可完成。有些需要和社交应用里根本不存在的人交谈，不知道他们在哪里。没有选项问NPC某些人在哪里。其他的想让我在空间站上揍某人……然后进监狱？

所以底线是，终于我可以给这个点赞了，不再无法使用了，耶！仍然远非硬核太空模拟……拜托，它在2D中飞行，飞船系统的复杂性就像幼儿园水平。这不是硬核，但由于烂透了的任务队列系统而难以处理。再入，天哪，那才是硬核的游戏单位。非常好的想法，好的美学设计，但缺乏系统设计，而且非常糟糕的
图形编程方面，鉴于我至今无法玩这个游戏。

items.text:
Whilst this game could allow for a lot replayability it has problems.

It lacks basic features that would improve the game a lot, it is needlessly complicated in some areas and front loaded. Yet somehow shallow. It lacks info about what anything does, like player traits.

Here is some simple things, what I think it needs as a priority:
Unable to quit to main menu from character creation, in case you pressed wrong button or wanna try again. 'Continue' on titlescreen is often for continuing a last save, should probably be called 'load'.
For some reason container items need to be interacting with and you need to select 'inventory'. Look I love inventory management, heck I love CDDA, but requiring the game to be unpaused to look at your items is not good. I cannot stress the amount this reduced my enjoyment. Having to check everythings inventory is tedious.
Unable to label or change name of items, that glass bottle of 'vodka' you have for coffee? Yeah your gonna have to use the previous inventory checking each time you want to go through your stuff, as you can't tell at a glance what's in it?
Using control to pick up single items from a stack is impossible, you use control to instead 'place' one from the stack? Seems backwards.
Kicks you out of nav panel on ships when closing the ship menu, very annoying when you are learning the game and after still annoying.
No way to 'cancel' a move command easily.
The ship travel menu is a mess, trying to move around the map is sensitive and annoying, Trying to figure out your heading AND viewing your target is very difficult. This COULD be forgiven if better navigation parts are added later, but I seriously doubt such poor UI would be on every ship in galaxy. You can't even get predictions on where an object is travel that you have targeted, or even the angle between you and the target.

Other areas to improve:
The OST is not very good, it could use better music. I turned it off after a bit. The first one is good for the character creation though.
Traits that do nothing.
Poor variety of items and parts, every ship starts to look the same in terms of parts.
All ships have the same UI?
Some traits or skills aren't trainable?
Unclear to the players when stuff needs to be paid.
No 'buffer' for new characters from fees, means 100% your first character you spent time on will be a waste, should be able to 'pre' save already built characters with same parents, etc.
Changing your last name does not affect your origins.
All the 'mothers' I get look like dudes, tested 8/10 times, same with weird looking fathers. Why assign parents at all? They don't appear to affect your story in the slightest? Character creation options are limited, n general the options for females in particular are bad, I tried playing a few times and once it gave me a female character, after wasting time making a character I realised that it just puts a different face only, it kinda looks goofy on top of the default male body. But across the board it is lacking, you can't even make a character that looks like the loading screens... or even 'normal' looking.
The loan system for your ship seems a bit weird? You can loan for a $800,000 ship, but can't for a $80,000 + some extra like gear? Or a license? I dunno man. Stuff doesn't make sense, in the description of one ship it mentions you worked on it... why can't you work on the cheapest ship?
The LONG saving times, are an issue.
The character creation is sometimes annoying, 'seek ship' should not show the same ship more then once, even if it adds more time the next time you look.
NPCs steal your items? Items disappearing? Had to reload as a core item like my helmet disappeared.
Uninstalling parts in your ship and they appear outside the ship... serious issue as there is no way to go outside? Even from port?


I tried to enjoy this game as it seems to have all the elements for a game I would enjoy but it is half baked at least for now and I just don't. It ain't even that deep either, even though it seems complicated up front, once you play a little bit it is a really simple game.

Still all that said I still think this will be a good game after some updates, unfortunately from what I can see that would take at least 3 years at current rate of development to where I would consider this game playable.
items.text_zh:
虽然这款游戏可能允许大量重复游玩，但它存在问题。

它缺乏能大幅改善游戏的基础功能，在某些方面不必要地复杂且前置内容过多。然而不知怎的又很浅薄。它缺乏关于任何东西作用的说明，比如玩家特质。

以下是一些简单的事情，我认为它需要优先处理：
无法从角色创建退出到主菜单，以防你按错了按钮或想再试一次。标题画面上的“继续”通常是用来继续上次存档的，可能应该叫“加载”。
不知为何容器物品需要与之互动，然后你需要选择“库存”。听着，我喜欢库存管理，见鬼，我喜欢CDDA，但要求游戏取消暂停才能查看你的物品并不好。我无法强调这减少了我多少乐趣。不得不检查每样东西的库存很乏味。
无法给物品贴标签或更改名称，你那瓶用来配咖啡的“伏特加”玻璃瓶？是啊，每次你想翻找你的东西时，都得用之前说的检查库存，因为你无法一眼看出里面是什么？
使用control从一堆物品中拾取单个物品是不可能的，你用control反而是从堆里“放置”一个？似乎反了。
在飞船上关闭飞船菜单时，会把你踢出导航面板，在你学习游戏时非常烦人，之后仍然烦人。
没有简单的方法“取消”移动命令。
飞船旅行菜单一团糟，试图在地图上移动既敏感又烦人，试图弄清你的航向同时查看你的目标非常困难。如果以后加入更好的导航部件，这还可以原谅，但我严重怀疑银河系每艘飞船上都会有这么糟糕的UI。你甚至无法获得你所瞄准物体移动方向的预测，甚至无法获得你与目标之间的角度。

其他需要改进的地方：
原声带不太好，可以用更好的音乐。我听了一会儿就关掉了。不过第一首对角色创建来说不错。
毫无作用的特质。
物品和部件种类贫乏，每艘飞船在部件方面开始看起来都一样。
所有飞船都有相同的UI？
有些特质或技能无法训练？
玩家不清楚什么时候需要付费。
新角色没有针对费用的“缓冲”，意味着你花时间创建的第一个角色100%会白费，应该能够“预先”保存已经创建好的、拥有相同父母等的角色。
更改你的姓氏不会影响你的出身。
我得到的所有“母亲”看起来都像男人，测试了8/10次，长相奇怪的“父亲”也一样。为什么要分配父母呢？他们似乎丝毫不影响你的故事？角色创建选项有限，总的来说尤其是女性的选项很糟糕，我试玩了几次，有一次给了我一个女性角色，在浪费时间创建角色后我意识到它只是换了一张不同的脸，放在默认男性身体上看起来有点滑稽。但总体而言它很欠缺，你甚至无法创建一个看起来像加载画面里的角色……甚至看起来“正常”的都不行。
你飞船的贷款系统似乎有点奇怪？你可以贷款买一艘800,000美元的飞船，但不能贷款买一艘80,000美元加一些额外东西比如装备的？或者一张执照？我不知道，老兄。事情说不通，在一艘飞船的描述中提到你曾在它上面工作过……为什么你不能在最便宜的飞船上工作？
漫长的保存时间是个问题。
角色创建有时很烦人，“寻找飞船”应该
不要在你下次查看时再次显示同一艘飞船，即使这会增加更多时间。
NPC会偷你的物品？物品消失？不得不重新加载，因为像我的头盔这样的核心物品消失了。
卸载你飞船上的部件，它们却出现在飞船外面……严重问题，因为根本没有办法出去？甚至从港口也不行？


我试着享受这款游戏，因为它似乎具备了一款我会喜欢的游戏的所有元素，但至少目前它是半生不熟的，我就是不喜欢。它甚至也没那么有深度，尽管乍一看似乎很复杂，一旦你玩上一小会儿，它其实是一款非常简单的游戏。

尽管如此，我仍然认为在经过一些更新后这会是一款好游戏，不幸的是，据我所见，以目前的开发速度，至少需要3年才能达到我认为这款游戏可玩的程度。

items.text:
I want to like Ostranauts and it definitely has potential but suffers from odd design choices that just aren't appealing. First impressions matter right? Well, starting with character creation there are already issues. You start at age 18 and to improve your character you age up to get money, learn skills and swap out traits. Except if you choose the wrong tab option like you pick the one for traits instead of skills, there's no back button. When it comes to traits you randomly get bad ones added back after character creation which while not impossible irl, in a game it's annoying to see traits like unfit (which takes 3 years to remove) show up again after I just got rid of it (btw once you get old you're more prone to bad traits and there's a cap at around 47-48). Oh, and once you get a ship you're kicked out of character creation, so if you won one gambling but there's a skill you wanted TOO BAD. I've unfortunately already spent hours trying to make what I feel would be a decent character.

As for the rest of the game, there are more issues like interacting with npcs. Whenever you start talking with someone for some reason that's a signal for every other damm npc to come and talk to the same person. They can only respond to one person at a time so you end up having to wait for them to get back to you. There's not even an option to invite them to speak in private somewhere else which could easily fix this. Then the dialogue itself is a bit confusing since some of the options are general conversation and some are you saying specific things or an action like nodding plus there's stuff titled like "shoot the breeze" which means idle chatting but why not have simple naming convention for better comprehension and accessibility for players? I don't get it.

Last thing I want to add is I think the tutorial could be improved, especially with the ship maintenance and what it requires to function. Instead of telling the player to immediately fly out after fixing the navigation there could be some explaining of how you need to watch your batteries for power and similar finite ship resources like oxygen and fuel and more on how you do maintenance. My first run after doing the practice flying of the tutorial I had no power left when I docked to a wreck and got stuck.
items.text_zh:
我想喜欢Ostranauts，它绝对有潜力，但受困于一些奇怪的设计选择，实在不吸引人。第一印象很重要，对吧？好吧，从角色创建开始就已经有问题了。你从18岁开始，为了提升角色，你要增加年龄来获得金钱、学习技能和更换特质。但如果你选错了标签页选项，比如你选了特质而不是技能的那个，就没有返回按钮。说到特质，在角色创建之后，你会随机被加回一些坏特质，虽然这在现实中并非不可能，但在游戏里，看到像不健康（需要3年才能移除）这样的特质在我刚刚摆脱它之后又出现，真的很烦人（顺便说一句，一旦你变老，你就更容易获得坏特质，而且大约在47-48岁有个上限）。哦，还有，一旦你获得了一艘船，你就会被踢出角色创建，所以如果你在赌博中赢了一艘船，但有个你想要的技能，那就太糟糕了。不幸的是，我已经花了几个小时试图做出我觉得还算体面的角色。

至于游戏的其余部分，还有更多问题，比如与NPC互动。每当你开始和某人交谈时，不知为何这就成了信号，让其他所有该死的NPC都过来和同一个人说话。他们一次只能回应一个人，所以你最终不得不等他们回复你。甚至没有选项邀请他们到别处私下交谈，这本来可以轻松解决这个问题。然后对话本身也有点令人困惑，因为有些选项是普通对话，有些是你说具体的话或做一个动作，比如点头，还有像“闲聊”这样的标题，意思是闲谈，但为什么不用简单的命名约定来让玩家更好地理解和上手呢？我不明白。

最后我想补充的是，我认为教程可以改进，尤其是在飞船维护以及它运行所需的条件方面。与其在修好导航后立即告诉玩家飞出去，不如解释一下你需要留意电池电量，以及类似的有限飞船资源，如氧气和燃料，还有更多关于如何进行维护的内容。我的第一次运行，在完成教程的练习飞行后，当我停靠到一艘残骸时，我没有电了，然后就被困住了。

With the amount of time that's passed since my original review, I feel safe to say, that the game is flawed fundamentally. A lot of my hours have been forced to try and just sit down and enjoy it, but frankly, I never find myself coming back. 

The gameplay loop feels too dull, the social mechanics feel very janky- and in all, there's a lot of meat, but it's kind of spoiled.

I cannot recommend this game. If you enjoy slower paces and somewhat more monotonous gameplay, this might be up your alley. But for the average person, I couldn't recommend this.


ORIGINAL REVIEW:
An amazing game, but I can't recommend it in the state it's in right now. Devs have the skeleton of the game, but there's still no meat on it yet. Fun for a little while- but if you're buying this game, you're in for the long haul until they get more of it done.

Currently, the loop would be this. Get lucky to get 5 grand for a salvage license on the story maker. Go to your ship. Find a derelict with a reactor, harvest the reactor, sell it for 48 grand, go back out, find another ship with a reactor, get it to work so you can carry more salvage, salvage more stuff, sell more stuff, salvage more stuff, rinse and repeat. They only just got combat done in April 6th, and they're still not done with long distance travel.

------

EDIT: The game has more meat on its bones, but it's still extremely buggy. Four interactions, and suddenly my social UI bricks, and now I can no longer click on the floor to move or scroll in shops and have to restart the game.

We're taking steps forward, but still, deveopment is slow.
items.text_zh:
距离我最初的评测已经过去了这么长时间，我可以放心地说，这款游戏存在根本性的缺陷。我的很多游戏时间都是强迫自己坐下来试着享受它，但坦白说，我从来不会主动想再回来玩。

游戏循环感觉太乏味了，社交机制感觉非常生硬——总的来说，内容很多，但有点变味了。

我不能推荐这款游戏。如果你喜欢较慢的节奏和某种程度上更单调的玩法，这也许合你的口味。但对普通人来说，我无法推荐它。


原始评测：
一款很棒的游戏，但以它目前的状态，我不能推荐它。开发者已经有了游戏的骨架，但上面还没有肉。能好玩一小会儿——但如果你买这款游戏，你就得做好长期等待的准备，直到他们完成更多内容。

目前，游戏循环是这样的。运气好拿到五千块，在故事模式里买一张打捞许可证。去你的飞船。找到一艘带有反应堆的废弃飞船，拆下反应堆，以四万八千块卖掉，再出去，找到另一艘带有反应堆的飞船，让它运转起来，这样你就能携带更多打捞物，打捞更多东西，卖掉更多东西，打捞更多东西， rinse and repeat。他们直到4月6日才刚做完战斗系统，而且长距离旅行还没做完。

------

编辑：游戏骨架上的肉更多了，但仍然有极其多的漏洞。四次互动之后，我的社交界面突然就坏了，现在我再也无法点击地板来移动，也无法在商店里滚动，只能重启游戏。

我们在向前迈进，但开发仍然很慢。

items.text:
Update 2: It's definitely possible to have adventures, but it's still a bit buggy.

For some reason there's a tooltip around your cursor that never goes away once it's there, and it doesn't really seem to be meaningful what it's there for.

The tutorial, while more helpful than the last one, misses important steps. Like putting on a pressure suit and helmet before getting into a small tug that has no atmosphere past the airlock at all (despite it seeming that way to a newbie).

There's definitely more stuff to do. Dialogue has become a bit more painful in my opinion than it was, due to all the available fighting options. It feels like that's going to result in some unintentional fisticuffs at some point.

Summary: It's getting closer to a recommendation, but it's obviously not done yet. Pick it up if you want to play around with a fairly advanced topdown space simulation game with some nice flavour, but expect it to be a bit buggy/hard to understand.

Update: Things are looking and feeling a lot more playable now. I haven't done much yet, but if it turns out you can have a full on adventure without too many bugs, I might flip this to a "Yes" - though there's clearly a lot more to be done.

Original: I'm sure this game will improve over time, as there is lots of potential -- but right now, I can't progress past the "salvage pod" stage, as I can't seem to get navigation to work at all. I had a similar problem in the demo launched a few weeks ago as well, but figured this bug would be ironed out before the EA release.

As things are *right now*, it's not recommended that anyone buy this game if not for supporting the developer.
items.text_zh:
更新2：绝对有可能展开冒险，但还是有点bug。

不知为何，你的光标周围有一个提示框，一旦出现就永远不会消失，而且它到底为什么在那里似乎也没什么意义。

教程虽然比上一个更有帮助，但遗漏了重要步骤。比如在进入一艘小型拖船之前要穿上压力服和头盔，而那艘拖船在气闸之外根本没有大气（尽管对新手来说看起来像是有的）。

确实有更多事情可做了。在我看来，由于所有可用的战斗选项，对话变得比之前更痛苦了。感觉这迟早会导致一些非本意的拳脚相向。

总结：它越来越接近值得推荐了，但显然还没做完。如果你想玩一款相当进阶、带有一些不错风味的俯视角太空模拟游戏，那就入手吧，但要做好它有点bug/难以理解的准备。

更新：现在看起来和感觉起来都更可玩了。我还没做太多，但如果结果证明你可以在没有太多bug的情况下展开一场完整的冒险，我可能会把它改成“是”——不过显然还有很多工作要做。

原文：我相信这款游戏会随着时间推移而改进，因为它很有潜力——但现在，我无法通过“打捞舱”阶段，因为我似乎完全没法让导航运作起来。几周前发布的试玩版里我也遇到过类似问题，但以为这个bug会在EA发布前被解决。

就*现在*的情况而言，除非是为了支持开发者，否则不建议任何人购买这款游戏。

Game has some good concepts, but its actually not enjoyable, and way too unpolished to be called an EA tittle. Loaded 2 saves because: 1 i didnt know what to do (no tutorial), or 2 game had some UI bugs that i couldnt pass on.

I will put this game thumbs down for now; I believe that games should not come to steam before reaching a stable state, in wich players are not required as QA testers, but to try and enjoy a mid-road to completion experience.

If this changes in the future i will update this review again, but for now i would search other experiences for this price tag.

UPDATE 11/09/2020: The dev published a community prefab roadmap, and i kinda consider its a lost cause, the game doesnt really have a "goal" to reach.

I'm a huge fan of the dev's previous game, Neo Scavenger.
While this new project shows a lot of potential, right now there are just way too many bugs and UI issues present. Plus making out what things in the game world are supposed to be is, at least for me, *extremely* difficult.
I'll keep an eye on the development of this game, but for now I can't recommend it.
